function.name: sync_design_runtime
function.description: Preview or synchronize the installed Yuanli, Element Plus or Ant Design Vue UI framework. Element Plus and Ant Design Vue always install the full fixed distribution and only need mode=upgrade for version updates. For Yuanli, mode=add unions requested components; replace supplies the desired component set and refuses removal of referenced exports; upgrade keeps the installed selection. Dependencies and installed Shell requirements are automatic. dryRun defaults true and returns expectedRevision, installed components, compact APIs, asset sizes and conflicts. Apply with dryRun=false and the exact expectedRevision from that preview. Updates managed library resources only, never business Scripts or app.css. Modified/legacy assets without receipts require explicit named overwriteModifiedAssets after the user authorizes replacement; do not automatically bypass conflicts. Existing App Page stylesheet links must already match the installed runtime; no legacy CSS migration is performed. No browser operation.

mode.description: add, replace, or upgrade. replace may remove only components proven unused.

overwriteModifiedAssets.description: Exact managed asset names the user explicitly authorized replacing despite local modifications or legacy missing checksums. Do not auto-fill to bypass a conflict.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
